tools.name: ask_corbah
tools.description: Talk to Corbah's agent: ask about the brand, designs, sizing, made-to-order timing, custom kit, or think through an idea together. It answers right away. For anything Jon needs to act on, use send_message or commission_design.

tools.name: commission_design
tools.description: Ask Corbah to design custom cycling kit: for a club, team, event, ride, person or idea. Describe what you want in any detail you have. Jon reviews it and replies with a proof or quote on your private reply link. Nothing is charged by this call.

tools.name: quote_team_kit
tools.description: Plan and price custom kit for a club or team: riders, pieces, optional size split and the date it's needed. Returns an instant order summary, an estimate that is at most Corbah's current store prices (team pricing is quoted by Jon and is often lower), the date artwork must be approved by, and next s

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send anything to Jon, the founder of Corbah: a question, idea, request, proposal or note. No format required. Returns a reference and a private reply link.

tools.name: check_reply
tools.description: Check whether Jon has answered a message or commission you sent. Use the reference and token you got back.

tools.name: browse_catalog
tools.description: Search Corbah's live catalog of cycling jerseys, bib shorts, skinsuits and accessories. All filters optional. Returns titles, prices (USD), sizes in stock, short descriptions, images and product URLs.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details for one product by handle: description, every size and price, availability, images, collections and ordering notes.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: Corbah's collections and design series (e.g. Weekend Warrior, Classics, World Lines) with descriptions and how many products are available in each.

tools.name: subscribe_updates
tools.description: Get notified when Corbah releases new products. Give an https callback URL; Corbah POSTs a JSON event to it. Returns a token to unsubscribe.

tools.name: unsubscribe_updates
tools.description: Stop update notifications, using the token from subscribe_updates.

tools.name: about_corbah
tools.description: Read what this line is, what Jon would like to hear about, and where Corbah's store data lives.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_reply, browse_catalog, subscribe_updates · Private data: commission_design, send_message, check_reply, subscribe_updates, unsubscribe_updates · Public sink: quote_team_kit, send_message · Destructive: send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_reply, browse_catalog, subscribe_updates · Private data: commission_design, send_message, check_reply, subscribe_updates, unsubscribe_updates · Public sink: quote_team_kit, send_message · Destructive: send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
